title: In Canada: Angine de Poitrine, PUP & More Make SOCAN Polaris Song Prize Short List
summary: Also this week: SOCAN acquires the Canadian Musical Reproduction Rights Agency (CMRRA).
body: The SOCAN Polaris Song Prize has revealed its second-ever short list. This year’s edition features songs by Angine de Poitrine, Charlotte Cornfield, PUP, Patrick Watson & Martha Wainwright and Charlotte Day Wilson, featuring Saya Gray. title: BE:FIRST Is Ready for the World: Inside the J-Pop Superstars’ Long-Planned U.S. Breakthrough
summary: The chart-topping Japanese boy band is taking on the U.S. market with new partners including The Orchard, THE·TEAM and Nebula17.
body: BE:FIRST boasts a dozen No. 1s on the Billboard Japan Hot 100 , played its first stadium concerts this past spring and has a world tour set for the fall. Now, the group is officially unveiling the first step in its effort to rise to greater prominence in the U.S. market. With the release of its new single, “BRUCE WAYNE,” the J-pop band is revealing its new U.S. distribution partnership with The Orchard, along with hello82 for physical distribution, Tom Windish at THE·TEAM for touring outside Asia, and ex-AVEX USA CEO Naoki Osada ‘s Nebula17 for A&R and marketing initiatives. body: All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. Netflix’s KPop Demon Hunters continues to expand its growing lineup of collectibles with a new blind box featuring phone huggers. The CultureFly release is the latest mystery-box merchandise inspired by the breakout animated musical hit, joining previous collectibles, like instant noodle-themed blind boxes , Funko Pops! and keychain charms . Now, fans have another chance to test their luck with a new series of miniature accessories that display their favorite heroes (and rivals) on phones and other electronic devices. KPop Demon Hunters has become one of Netflix’s biggest success stories, with its soundtrack dominating streaming charts and “Golden” winning an Oscar , not to mention HUNTR/X emerging as a genuine K-pop phenomenon. title: Karol G Invites ‘Everyone To Be A Little More Dramatic, A Little More Extra’ With New Album ‘No Me Arrepiento de Sentir Tanto’
summary: The Colombian artist’s sixth studio album arrives on Aug. 7.
body: Karol G understands that her fans value her honesty and that her success lies in her vulnerability as an artist. The Grammy winner announced Wednesday (July 29), while onstage, that her forthcoming studio album, No Me Arrepiento de Sentir Tanto (I Don’t Regret Feeling So Much), will arrive Aug. 7. The album is G’s sixth studio set and has already sparked speculation about whether the artist is planning a full rebrand following her Tropicoqueta era, which was coded with an upbeat, vibrant and celebratory style, accompanied by reds, yellow and orange sunset tones and an obvious display of Latin and Colombian pride. That influence is also visible in the performances on her Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour, which kicked off this month in Chicago. title: Cam’ron Shares a Wild Story Involving DMX, a Dog and a Raccoon
body: During a recent appearance on Talk With Flee , Cam’ron and co-host Sen City were talking about sample clearances when Sen brought up Killa’s “ Pull It ” collab with DMX , and asked if he had any memorable stories he was willing to share about the late rapper. That’s when Cam could barely keep himself together as he told a story about the time the two were staying in a hotel and X had allegedly set up a fight between his dog and a raccoon. “I was filming Paid in Full the same time he was filming [ Cradle 2 the Grave ] with Jet Li,” he began by saying, “We were both staying in the same hotel at the same time in Connecticut. And he had a dog, I can’t remember if it was Boomer or not — rest in peace, Boomer, you know he loved Boomer — but he had a dog in the hotel with him and we kept bumping into each other. And he’s like, ‘Yo, bro, what you doing later?’ And I’m like, ‘I just gotta film, I’ll be back’ and he said, ‘Oh, aight, good. title: TB 26-04 Webbings for Use in Elevated Oxygen Environments
summary: Flammability test results for commercial-off-the-shelf webbings that meet NASA flammability requirements are reported for use in elevated oxygen environments anticipated for future lunar and Martian missions. Testing demonstrated that a webbing composed of 60% Kevlar®/40% polybenzimidazole (PBI) fr…
body: Flammability test results for commercial-off-the-shelf webbings that meet NASA flammability requirements are reported for use in elevated oxygen environments anticipated for future lunar and Martian missions. Testing demonstrated that a webbing composed of 60% Kevlar®/40% polybenzimidazole (PBI) from Sturges Manufacturing Company, Inc., specifically the natural version, passed flammability testing per NASA-STD-6001B Test 1 using a surface ignition in J-configuration at 37% oxygen and 8.2 psia. Offgassing data are also provided for the natural webbing, which is gold colored. These findings support their potential use as suitable webbings for softgoods applications, although final performance and wear characteristics must be validated in full configuration. Background An elevated oxygen environment is planned for future crewed missions to the Moon and Mars to reduce the prebreathe time before extravehicular activities. In this study, materials are being evaluated for use at 37% oxygen and 8.2 psia. An enriched oxygen environment increases the flammability risk and the need for improved fire-resistant materials.
